references.text: God commands Moses to place the testimony (the tablets of the law) in the ark, which is done here.
The original instruction to put the mercy seat on the ark and place the testimony inside it.
The instruction to attach the carrying poles to the ark, which Moses carries out here.
Moses receives the two tablets of the testimony, which are what is placed in the ark.
Description of the tablets of the testimony that Moses brought down from the mountain.
Moses comes down from Sinai with the two tablets of the testimony after the first ones were broken.
Moses confirms that he placed the tablets in the ark as God commanded.
Confirms that there was nothing else in the ark except the two tablets Moses laid down at Horeb.
The New Testament refers to the ark of the covenant which contained the tablets of the law and the mercy seat.
